boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus places for studying, making, gathering, seeing art, hearing music, moving, and spending time outdoors.

cards.title: Collins Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Research, reading rooms, and reservable study space
cards.notes: Start with a floor-by-floor lap, then choose a reading room, couch, or study room that fits your work. Book group space when you need a shared table.
cards.short_summary: A five-floor academic base with individual and group work options.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says Collins Memorial Library offers individual and group study spaces across five floors and provides 63 study rooms.
cards.source_title: Academic Resources & Support | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Use the library’s current access and room-booking information before planning a group session.

cards.entity_name: To the Heights Quiet Study Space
cards.title: To the Heights quiet study
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Bring focused work to the library’s fourth floor and use the quiet-study setting when you need fewer interruptions. Check current library access details first.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-study area with campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: Collins Library identifies “To the Heights” on its fourth floor as a quiet study space with views.
cards.source_title: Dr. Annie Downey extends a warm welcome to all! | Collins Unbound
cards.access_notes: Located inside Collins Memorial Library; observe posted quiet-study and building-access expectations.

cards.entity_name: Collins Creative Center: Makerspace and Printing Press Studio
cards.title: Collins Creative Center
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Plan a creative break around the Makerspace or Printing Press Studio, and confirm current drop-in times or equipment procedures before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level library space for hands-on creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies the Collins Creative Center’s Makerspace and Printing Press Studio on the lower level.
cards.source_title: Dr. Annie Downey extends a warm welcome to all! | Collins Unbound
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current Makerspace hours and any required training before using equipment.

cards.title: Wheelock Student Center
cards.subtitle: Campus community center
cards.notes: Use Wheelock as a practical meeting point: check the Rotunda and meeting areas, then combine errands such as mail, student-government business, or a meal.
cards.short_summary: A central student-services and gathering hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes Wheelock Student Center as the campus activity hub and lists KUPS, ASUPS, mail services, dining, and student-support offices there.
cards.source_title: Student Life Resources | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Services and room availability vary; consult the relevant office or current Student Center information before a visit.

cards.title: Puget Sound Community Garden
cards.subtitle: Student-run campus garden
cards.notes: Walk through the garden, read the posted guidance, and contact Garden Club if you want to join a workday or learn what is growing.
cards.short_summary: A visitor-welcoming garden used for learning and food growing.
cards.evidence_claim: Puget Sound calls this a student-run campus garden that is open to visitors and used by classes as a learning space.
cards.source_title: Puget Sound Community Garden | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: The garden asks visitors to read signs and respect the shared space.

cards.title: Brown Family Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Science Center courtyard between Harned and Thompson halls
cards.notes: Pause between classes in the landscaped courtyard, then look down at the patterned floor and around for the science-on-display installations.
cards.short_summary: A multi-level science courtyard with study and gathering areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the Brown Family Courtyard has native landscaping, a research garden, water feature, study and gathering spaces, and science displays.
cards.source_title: Science Center | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Located within the Science Center; be mindful of classes, research activity, and café operations nearby.

cards.title: Kilworth Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus chapel and performance space
cards.notes: Look for a public lecture, concert, vigil, or spiritual-life program, and take time to notice the sanctuary and the building’s inclusive purpose.
cards.short_summary: A campus venue for reflection, performances, and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says Kilworth Chapel hosts performances, classes, lectures, spiritual services, and a multifaith meeting room and Islamic Prayer Space.
cards.source_title: Kilworth Memorial Chapel | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Public access depends on scheduled events and reservations; verify the calendar or contact the chapel coordinator.

cards.title: Kittredge Gallery
cards.subtitle: Kittredge Hall art gallery
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition before you go, then build in time to view the work and any listed artist talk or reception.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery connecting exhibitions with art teaching.
cards.evidence_claim: Kittredge Gallery presents exhibitions and artist lectures and lists regular gallery hours Monday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Kittredge Gallery | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are listed as Monday–Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday noon–5 p.m., excluding university holidays.

cards.title: Schneebeck Concert Hall
cards.subtitle: School of Music performance venue
cards.notes: Browse the music calendar for a recital or concert, reserve a ticket if required, and arrive early enough to find general seating.
cards.short_summary: A major campus hall for concerts, recitals, and lectures.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies Schneebeck Concert Hall as a 500-seat campus performance venue; its Jacobsen Series concerts use general seating there.
cards.source_title: Jacobsen Concert Series | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Ticketing and admission vary by performance; current Puget Sound and K–12 students receive free admission to the Jacobsen Series with a complimentary ticket.

cards.title: Athletics & Aquatics Center
cards.subtitle: Recreation and athletics complex
cards.notes: Check the recreation schedule, bring your current university ID, and use the facility for a workout, swim, court time, or campus recreation activity.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation complex with courts, pool, and fitness facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the Athletics & Aquatics Center and Memorial Fieldhouse include basketball courts, fitness center, tennis pavilion, racquetball court, and swimming pool.
cards.source_title: Recreation Facilities Use | University of Puget Sound
cards.access_notes: Students, faculty, and staff need a valid current university ID for turnstile access; schedules and priority use can affect availability.
